item.title: Why are Americans so united against data centers?
item.description: During a time when Americans are mostly divided on the issues this election year, many are united around opposition to new data centers. Tony Dokoupil has "The Big Question."

item.title: Trump flew from Turkey on older plane after credible threat from Iran and proxies
item.description: President Trump departed the NATO summit in Turkey on an old Air Force One jet following a credible threat from Iran and allied proxy groups, U.S. officials told CBS News.

item.title: Trump attending White House Correspondents' Dinner redo after April attack
item.description: President Trump is attending the redo of the White House Correspondents' Dinner on Friday night, after an armed assailant upended April's dinner.

item.title: Pentagon under fire for dropping tally of troops killed in Iran from 18 to 14
item.description: The Pentagon came under fire this week after its tally of the number of troops killed in the Iran war suddenly dropped from 18 to 14. Charlie D'Agata has more details on the discrepancy.

item.title: Apalachee High School shooting suspect pleads guilty to all charges
item.description: Colt Gray was charged with 55 counts, including malice murder, and faces life in prison without parole for the deadly mass shooting at Apalachee High School.

item.title: All 11 on seaplane that crashed, caught fire north of Seattle survive
item.description: A seaplane crashed and caught fire a short time later in the Puget Sound area north of Seattle. All 11 people on board survived, authorities said.

item.title: White House Correspondents' Dinner to be scaled down, with scaled-up security
item.description: The White House Correspondents' Dinner will have a redo in Washington, D.C., on Friday night, after the original event was interrupted in April when a gunman stormed in. It'll be a scaled-down event with scaled-up security. Nicole Sganga reports.

item.title: Apalachee High School shooting suspect pleads guilty in Georgia courtroom
item.description: Nearly two years after a school shooting at Georgia's Apalachee High School, a 16-year-old pleaded guilty to killing two fellow students, two teachers and wounding nine other people in Georgia. Jericka Duncan reports.

item.title: Video shows plane slamming into rocky island off Washington state, all 11 on board survive
item.description: In Washington state, a plane skimmed over the water before slamming into a rocky island off the coast on Thursday. All 11 on board survived, and Carter Evans has the details.

item.title: Howard University student journalist honored at White House Correspondents' Dinner
item.description: The White House Correspondents' Dinner will honor student journalists and reporters from around the country on Friday night. One of those students, Ssanyu Lukoma, who attends Howard University, joins "The Takeout" to discuss what she wants out of a potential career in journalism.

item.title: Upper West Side double stabbing suspect facing hate crime charges
item.description: The suspect in Thursday's double stabbing​ on New York City's Upper West Side has been charged with attempted murder as a hate crime, among other things.

item.title: Here's why LeBron James might have chosen to join the Philadelphia 76ers over other NBA teams
item.description: Sports columnist for The Philadelphia Enquirer Mike Sielski joins "The Daily Report" to break down why basketball legend LeBron James might have chosen the Philadelphia 76ers as his next NBA home.

item.title: This week on "Sunday Morning" (July 26)
item.description: A look at the features for this week's broadcast of the Emmy-winning program, hosted by Jane Pauley.

item.title: Judge to decide if D4vid will stand trial for murder of 14-year-old girl amid doctor testimony
item.description: A judge is set to decide whether to move forward with a jury trial of singer D4vid in the case of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez's murder after the doctor who performed her autopsy delivered a disturbing testimony in a preliminary hearing. Adam Yamaguchi has more.

item.title: Iran keeps targeting American bases as U.S. interceptor stockpiles dwindle
item.description: Explosions were heard near a U.S. base in Iraq, and Iran said it targeted Bahrain, Jordan and Kuwait as the 21-week war intensifies.

item.title: LeBron James heading to Philly in deal with 76ers
item.description: The Sixers' wild offseason continued Friday when they added four-time NBA champion LeBron James.

item.title: What Trump's new "forced labor" tariffs on 60 economies will mean for U.S. consumers
item.description: President Trump announced a new set of tariffs ranging from 10% to 12.5% on 60 trade partners over "forced labor" concerns on Thursday, just as Mr. Trump's temporary 10% levy was due to expire. Olivia Rinaldi explains what this means for consumers.

item.title: LeBron James signing with Philadelphia 76ers for 24th NBA season
item.description: LeBron James announced Friday he is signing a two-year deal to play for the Philadelphia 76ers. The Athletic staff writer Tony Jones joins "The Takeout" with analysis.

item.title: Ossoff holds large lead in reelection bid, as Georgia governor's race is deadlocked, new poll finds
item.description: New AARP polling out of Georgia offers competing states in two elections, with Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff holding a nine-point lead in his reelection bid over GOP Rep. Mike Collins, and Democrat Keishia Lance Bottoms slightly ahead of Republican Rick Jackson in the governor's race, but within the margin of error. NOTUS reporter Kadia Goba and Atlanta Journal-Constitution Washington bureau chief Tia Mitchell join to discuss.

item.title: Why a DNC panel recommended South Carolina as first 2028 primary state
item.description: South Carolina is on track to be the first state to hold a 2028 Democratic presidential primary after a Democratic National Committee panel made the recommendation on Friday. CBS News political reporter Zak Hudak has the details.

item.title: Ontario Premier Doug Ford on Trump's new tariff threat: "It's unfortunate he took this avenue"
item.description: The U.S. on Friday imposed a new 10% tariff on Canada, with 50% duties set to take effect later in August, significantly escalating trade tensions between the two countries. Ontario Premier Doug Ford joins "The Takeout" with his reaction.

item.title: South Carolina on cusp of being first 2028 Democratic presidential primary state
item.description: The DNC Rules and Bylaws Committee voted Friday to recommend that South Carolina should hold the nation's first 2028 presidential nominating contest.

item.title: Inside D4vd's Preliminary Hearing in Murder Case | Case by Case
item.description: A preliminary hearing offers the clearest look yet at the case against singer-songwriter D4vd, who is charged with the murder of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. "48 Hours" correspondent Anne-Marie Green is joined by Los Angeles Times investigative crime writer Richard Winton to unpack the latest courtroom developments, the prosecution's strategy, the defense's response, and the evidence that could determine whether the case advances to trial.

item.title: Trump says Iran talks are ongoing, but doesn't think "they're ready yet" to make a deal
item.description: President Trump told reporters on Friday that although the U.S. is speaking with Iran after nearly two weeks of strikes, he doesn't think Tehran is yet prepared to reach an agreement. CBS News' Nikole Killion and Samantha Vinograd have the latest.

item.title: Paramount to delay Warner Bros. merger until as late as June 2027
item.description: Paramount Skydance on Friday said it would delay the deal until as late as June 2027.

item.title: Costa Rica captures top fugitive "Diablo," wanted by U.S.
item.description: Alejandro Arias-Monge, 41, had a $500,000 U.S. bounty on his head for alleged drug trafficking.

item.title: "The child is terrified": Doctors on front lines of measles comeback speak out
item.description: Confirmed measles cases in the U.S. just hit a 35-year high, and it's only July.

item.title: Pentagon website "anomalies" that removed names of 4 killed in Iran war remain
item.description: The Pentagon website, which was last updated on July 22, still showed only 14 killed in the conflict as of Friday.

item.title: Cyclospora outbreak linked to iceberg lettuce expands to 4 more states
item.description: The cyclosporiasis outbreak, the nation's largest, is currently affecting nine states.

item.title: Notable Deaths in 2026
item.description: A look back at the esteemed personalities who've left us this year, who'd touched us with their innovation, creativity and humanity.
